description: Add missing methods to BookController, RssSourceController, and RestVerticle/YueduApi that exist in the JAR but are absent or incorrectly implemented in source
steps: 1. In BookController.kt, add the missing public method `fun convertPdfToImage(book: Book, force: Boolean = false): Boolean` that converts all PDF pages to images for a book. The JAR signature is: `public final boolean convertPdfToImage(io.legado.app.data.entities.Book, boolean)`. This should use PDFBox to iterate all pages and save each as an image using savePdfPageToImage. The existing suspend fun convertPdfToImage(context: RoutingContext) is a DIFFERENT method (HTTP handler) and must remain.

2. In BookController.kt, change the existing `private fun convertPdfPageToImage(pdfFile: File, pageIndex: Int, dpi: Float): BufferedImage?` to be public and add an ADDITIONAL public method with JAR signature: `public final void convertPdfPageToImage(io.legado.app.data.entities.Book, int, boolean)` with default params. This version takes a Book, page index, and force flag, resolves the local file from the book, and calls savePdfPageToImage.

3. In BookController.kt, add the method `fun savePdfPageToImage(doc: PDDocument, renderer: PDFRenderer, pageIndex: Int, dpi: Float, userNameSpace: String, imageDir: File)` matching JAR signature: `public final void savePdfPageToImage(org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDDocument, org.apache.pdfbox.rendering.PDFRenderer, int, float, java.lang.String, java.io.File)`. This renders a page at given DPI and saves it as PNG in the specified directory. The existing suspend fun savePdfPageToImage(context: RoutingContext) is a DIFFERENT method (HTTP handler) and must remain.

4. In BookController.kt, add the missing public method `fun saveBookToShelf(book: Book, userNameSpace: String, context: RoutingContext): Pair<Book, String>` matching JAR signature: `public final kotlin.Pair<io.legado.app.data.entities.Book, java.lang.String> saveBookToShelf(io.legado.app.data.entities.Book, java.lang.String, io.vertx.ext.web.RoutingContext)`. This extracts the book-save-to-shelf logic from saveBook() into a reusable helper that returns the saved book and userNameSpace.

5. In BookController.kt, add the missing public method `suspend fun saveBookCover(book: Book, bookSource: String, userNameSpace: String)` matching JAR signature: `public final java.lang.Object saveBookCover(io.legado.app.data.entities.Book, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, kotlin.coroutines.Continuation<? super kotlin.Unit>)` with a $default variant. This downloads and saves the book cover image locally.

6. In RssSourceController.kt, add the missing method `suspend fun canEditRssSource(context: RoutingContext): Boolean` matching JAR signature: `public final java.lang.Object canEditRssSource(io.vertx.ext.web.RoutingContext, kotlin.coroutines.Continuation<? super java.lang.Boolean>)`. Follow the pattern from BookSourceController.canEditBookSource() but check userInfo.enable_rss_source instead.
7. In RestVerticle.kt, add the abstract method `abstract fun getContextPath(): String` to the RestVerticle class.

8. In YueduApi.kt, add `override fun getContextPath(): String` implementation. Based on the JAR, it should return the configured contextPath (from env property `reader.server.contextPath`, defaulting to empty string).
acceptance_criteria: Running `./gradlew compileKotlin compileJava -x test` passes with BUILD SUCCESSFUL

BookController has convertPdfToImage(Book, Boolean), convertPdfPageToImage(Book, Int, Boolean), savePdfPageToImage(PDDocument, PDFRenderer, Int, Float, String, File), saveBookToShelf(Book, String, RoutingContext), and saveBookCover(Book, String, String) as public methods
RssSourceController has canEditRssSource(RoutingContext) as a public suspend method
RestVerticle has abstract fun getContextPath(): String
YueduApi overrides getContextPath() returning the configured contextPath
verification: grep -n 'fun convertPdfToImage\|fun saveBookToShelf\|fun saveBookCover\|fun savePdfPageToImage\|fun convertPdfPageToImage' src/main/java/com/htmake/reader/api/controller/BookController.kt
